{{Otheruses|Chief Executive}}
'''Chief Executive''' was the term given to the leader of an [[Allied Command]] within the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. Chief Executives were responsible for leading their Command in a similar fashion to the [[Chief of State (Alliance)/Legends|Chief of State]], just on a smaller scale and confined to their own sphere of influence.

Chief Executives varied greatly from Command to Command. In some Commands, the Chief Executive was the ruler of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]], in others, the position was an elected or appointed one. The Chief Executive did not have to be a single individual, but could be a group such as a board of directors or an [[Alien/Legends|alien]] hive intelligence.
